correctness.rationale: The exact three-type transition counts AD, BC, BD were derived from the specified finite graph; the Exp(1/n) clock coupling has the correct uniform edge-order law. The martingale quadratic variation is O(T/n) on every bounded horizon; the drift is polynomial and Lipschitz. Exact solution of the fluid ODE gives I*=log(beta/alpha)/(beta-alpha), continuously 1/alpha on the diagonal, and terminal (a,b,c,d)=(r,0,r,0). Every future successful edge touches B or D, giving the pathwise tail bound and hence convergence to the terminal limit, including means by boundedness. Literal edge-order enumeration for n=2 agrees with exact rational DP; n=4 probabilities 22/63,184/315,1/15; additional finite symmetry and stochastic checks passed. All claims restricted to fixed alpha,beta in (0,1); no finite checks substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A structured forbidden biclique creates a natural, two-parameter kinetic competition between constrained and flexible sites. The derived exact limiting vacancy remains strictly positive even when the substrate satisfies Hall and admits perfect coverage; for alpha=beta=2/5 the deficit is (2/5)exp(-3/2), approximately 8.9 percent. It is a nontrivial physically interpretable irreversible-jamming invariant rather than a graph-renaming exercise, existing table lookup or generic random-greedy bound. Its explicit dependence and singular small-block behavior support reuse as a mean-field benchmark.
